paragraphs.text: Merrevia Sal was the sister of Arcades Sabboth , Chromium Rhuell , Palladia-Mors , Nicol Bolas , and Ugin . She was the cousin of Vaevictis Asmadi . After being spawned by The Ur-Dragon during the Birth of the Elder Dragons , she was killed by human hunters and their dogs . This act was witnessed by Ugin and Nicol Bolas , although their reactions to it differed. Merrevia Sal's death would later lead Bolas to start the Dragon-killers' War .
